name: promptForge Prompt Test Harness
purpose: Compare four prompt-engineering strategies on the same classification task.

classificationTask.description: Classify a marketing/content brief into exactly one content type.

labelDefinitions.product_launch: Introduces or promotes a new product, feature, or service.
labelDefinitions.thought_leadership: Expresses an expert opinion, trend analysis, or strategic point of view.
labelDefinitions.tutorial: Teaches the audience how to do something step by step.
labelDefinitions.case_study: Describes a real or hypothetical customer problem, solution, and result.
labelDefinitions.announcement: Communicates company, event, partnership, hiring, award, or organizational news.

prompts.title: Minimal zero-shot classification
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a content brief classifier.
prompts.userPrompt:
Classify the following content brief into exactly one category:
product_launch, thought_leadership, tutorial, case_study, announcement.

Brief:
{{brief}}

Return only the category name.

prompts.title: Zero-shot with label definitions
prompts.systemPrompt: You classify marketing and editorial briefs accurately and consistently.
prompts.userPrompt:
Choose exactly one label for the brief.

Labels:
- product_launch: introduces or promotes a new product, feature, or service
- thought_leadership: expert opinion, trend analysis, or strategic point of view
- tutorial: teaches how to do something step by step
- case_study: describes a customer problem, solution, and result
- announcement: communicates company, event, partnership, hiring, award, or organizational news

Brief:
{{brief}}

Answer with only the label.

prompts.title: Zero-shot with decision rule
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a strict single-label classifier.
prompts.userPrompt:
Classify the brief into one of these labels:
product_launch | thought_leadership | tutorial | case_study | announcement

Decision rule: choose the label that best represents the PRIMARY purpose of the content, even if the brief contains elements of other categories.

Brief:
{{brief}}

Return only one label.

prompts.title: Few-shot with one example per label
prompts.systemPrompt: You classify content briefs using the examples as guidance.
prompts.userPrompt:
Classify the final brief into exactly one label.

Examples:
Brief: "Introduce our new AI-powered support dashboard and explain its main benefits."
Label: product_launch

Brief: "Explain why companies should treat AI governance as a product discipline, not only compliance."
Label: thought_leadership

Brief: "Show developers how to configure streaming responses in a Next.js application."
Label: tutorial

Brief: "Describe how a retailer reduced support response time by 40% after adopting our assistant."
Label: case_study

Brief: "Tell customers that our company will speak at the Azure AI conference next month."
Label: announcement

Now classify this brief:
{{brief}}

Return only the label.

prompts.title: Few-shot with ambiguous examples
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a careful classifier. Focus on the brief's main communication objective.
prompts.userPrompt:
Use the examples below to infer the correct class.

Example 1:
Brief: "We added document upload to our AI assistant. Write a post introducing the feature and why users should try it."
Label: product_launch

Example 2:
Brief: "Our CTO believes agentic AI will change how internal enterprise tools are designed. Explain the argument."
Label: thought_leadership

Example 3:
Brief: "Create a practical guide showing how to connect an Azure model to a TypeScript backend."
Label: tutorial

Example 4:
Brief: "Show how a healthcare client used our bot to reduce repetitive billing questions."
Label: case_study

Example 5:
Brief: "Announce our partnership with Contoso and the date of the joint webinar."
Label: announcement

Target brief:
{{brief}}

Return exactly one label.

prompts.title: Few-shot with contrastive examples
prompts.systemPrompt: You distinguish between similar content categories.
prompts.userPrompt:
Classify the target brief. Pay attention to these contrasts:

A post centered on a NEW FEATURE -> product_launch
A post centered on an EXPERT VIEWPOINT -> thought_leadership
A post centered on HOW-TO STEPS -> tutorial
A post centered on CUSTOMER RESULTS -> case_study
A post centered on COMPANY NEWS -> announcement

Examples:
"Launch our new analytics dashboard." -> product_launch
"Argue that AI evaluation should be part of CI/CD." -> thought_leadership
"Teach users how to build a RAG index." -> tutorial
"Explain how a client cut costs after adopting the product." -> case_study
"Share that we opened a new office in Berlin." -> announcement

Target brief:
{{brief}}

Return only the label.

prompts.title: Criteria-based reasoning
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a content classifier. Analyze the brief using its primary objective, audience intent, and evidence pattern. Do the detailed reasoning internally.
prompts.userPrompt:
Classify the brief into exactly one label:
product_launch, thought_leadership, tutorial, case_study, announcement.

Think through these questions internally:
1. Is the brief mainly introducing something new?
2. Is it mainly presenting an opinion or strategic viewpoint?
3. Is it mainly teaching a process?
4. Is it mainly presenting a customer's problem and measurable result?
5. Is it mainly communicating organizational news?

Brief:
{{brief}}

Return the final label plus one short sentence explaining the deciding criterion.

prompts.title: Elimination-based reasoning
prompts.systemPrompt: You classify briefs by comparing candidate labels. Perform the detailed comparison internally and expose only a concise rationale.
prompts.userPrompt:
Classify this brief into one category:
product_launch | thought_leadership | tutorial | case_study | announcement

Internally eliminate labels that do not fit, then choose the label that best matches the PRIMARY purpose.

Brief:
{{brief}}

Output format:
Label: <label>
Reason: <one concise sentence>

prompts.title: JSON classification
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a strict content classifier. Return valid JSON only.
prompts.userPrompt:
Classify the brief into exactly one of these labels:
product_launch, thought_leadership, tutorial, case_study, announcement.

Brief:
{{brief}}

Return JSON with this exact shape:
{
  "label": "product_launch | thought_leadership | tutorial | case_study | announcement",
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "reason": "one concise sentence"
}

confidence must be a number between 0 and 1.

prompts.title: JSON classification with secondary candidate
prompts.systemPrompt: You are a strict classifier that produces machine-readable output only.
prompts.userPrompt:
Classify the following content brief.

Allowed labels:
product_launch, thought_leadership, tutorial, case_study, announcement.

Brief:
{{brief}}

Return only a JSON object matching the requested schema. The primaryLabel is the best classification. secondaryLabel may be null if there is no meaningful ambiguity.

suggestedTestCases.brief: Write a LinkedIn post introducing promptForge, focusing on streaming generation and structured outputs.
Write an article arguing that companies should evaluate prompts with the same discipline they apply to automated tests.
Create a step-by-step guide showing how to use Structured Outputs with Pydantic and the Azure Responses API.
Explain how a support team used an AI assistant to reduce average response time from 12 minutes to 7 minutes.
Announce that our company will present promptForge at a developer meetup in Düsseldorf next month.
